description: Drainage Nodes Wanneroo (WAN-002) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Wanneroo. City of Wanneroo Drainage Nodes. Coverage: City of Wanneroo. The portal files it under the publisher City of Wanneroo. Its tags are Harvested, SLIP Future, drainage, infrastructure, lga. It offers 3 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
